description: A pink smartphone lies on a green bedsheet near a white charging cable, with a large white board propped up in the corner. The right hand reaches toward the phone, grasps it as a right-hand object, lifts and slightly rotates it while the left hand moves in to take hold of the cable end as a left-hand object; then the cable is pulled free from the phone, and the right hand sets the unplugged phone back down.
